outcome: Elective cesarean section (term and post-term breech pregnancies)
Induction of labor (term and post-term pregnancies)
Birth setting in assumed low-risk pregnancies
cohort: 1,532,441 singleton pregnancies in the Netherlands between 2000 and 2008
finding: Higher hospital density was not associated with more obstetric interventions, and non-Western ethnicity and living in low socioeconomic status neighborhoods were associated with a lower probability of interventions, suggesting inequalities in obstetric care utilization in the Netherlands.
